pages.text: Hafnium-178m2 holds 2.4 MeV in each nucleus, locked in by its spin, for thirty-one years: $(thing)1.3 TJ$() a kilogram. The Cyclotron makes it from rare earths (hafnium travels with them) above 6 MeV.
The $(item)Isomer Trigger$() knocks it loose with a gamma pulse from a Cobalt-57 source, and all of it comes out at once - a great deal of power, and plain hafnium dust.
